description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mirrorhall Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirrorhall Mimic from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
